text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been three years since Gold Ship and
I started
working together, and we've
overcome all sorts of
obstacles as a
team.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm just about to go and share the happy
news
with her, when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: CRASH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The distinct sound of something getting

destroyed reaches my ear, and the floor
shakes
beneath my feet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What in the world is going on?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Great day for renovations,
don'tcha
think?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What are you freaking out about? I'm
just doing
some DIY.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I was free climbing up the side of the
main school
building early this morning
when I ran into the
Don. Y'know, the big
boss 'round here?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, she congratulated me on the
awesome
three years you and I've had at
the academy, and
wished us luck in the
future.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So I figured if we're gonna keep hanging
around
here, wouldn't it be a good idea
to make this
place a bit cozier?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, now that I've explained myself,
I'm
gonna install a nice aquarium for us
to raise sea
anemones in.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't even know where to begin, but I
give it my
best shot.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't worry. I already got the green
light
from the Don.
choice_data_list: 勝手に工事して大丈夫……？
choice_data_list_en: Is it okay to do construction without permission...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, you really need to start getting
used to
stuff like this.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We've still got a whole lotta ranks to
climb
together in the world of
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Your heart's gonna give before long if
you let
every little thing freak you out.
You gotta train
yourself till nothing
fazes you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Catch my drift? Now, I've got a tank to
fetch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her breezy brazenness catches me off
guard, but
one thing in particular sticks
with me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship still wants to keep walking her
path
with me. That just makes my whole
day!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aw, heck. The tank doesn't fit.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Lend me a hand here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It certainly won't be smooth sailing, but I
have a
feeling things will work out!
